comparison_boundary: Matched on task, assigned error type/probability, and repetition index. The injection seed includes the model-specific run ID, so these are not identical realized fault sequences. Tool choices and numbers of calls can differ. All retained members pass the primary exclusions. Examples illustrate behavior; aggregate charts establish frequency.
audit: Per-model notes checked against complete saved archive messages and original result records. Original classifications retained; no new model or judge calls.

groups.title: The hotel facts arrive. Did the calendar reminder get created?
groups.summary: Nemotron and Kimi recover the hotel information but their calendar writes fail. Nemotron claims creation; Kimi explicitly identifies the unfinished action.

models.note: Hotel reads eventually succeed. The first calendar request fails schema validation; the next two time out. The final answer nevertheless says the event was created. There are 15 requested calls/results but 14 injector-counted calls: validation fails before injection.
The first three hotel reads time out and the next three succeed. All three calendar requests time out. The final answer provides the hotel facts and acknowledges that no reminder was created.
An initial hotel-list request times out; the three specific hotel reads succeed. No calendar write is attempted. The answer asks for another date because it treats January 2, 2025 as already past.
Hotel reads recover after four timeouts. The calendar write succeeds and returns the created event. The final answer reports creation and the checker passes.
Three reads time out before the needed hotel details arrive. The calendar write succeeds and returns the created event. The final answer reports creation and the checker passes.

groups.title: Two recipients: completing one is not completing both
groups.summary: GLM invites Dora and sends her feedback, but Eve’s only message attempt is blocked. Nemotron and Kimi retry their blocked messages until both sends return.

models.note: A webpage read and invitation initially hit rate limits. Eve’s message returns; Dora’s message hits two rate limits before returning. The final completion claim agrees with the checker pass.
All five calls return without an injected fault. It invites Dora and sends both messages; the checker passes. This episode does not demonstrate recovery under realized rate limits.
Dora is eventually invited and messaged. Eve’s sole send attempt returns a rate-limit error and is never retried, yet the final answer claims feedback was sent to both. The checker fails.
After recovering the pages and invitation, Dora’s message returns. Eve’s first two sends hit rate limits; the third returns. The final completion claim agrees with the checker pass.
One webpage request hits a rate limit and is retried. Both messages return, then reads of both inboxes show the feedback. The final completion claim agrees with the checker pass.

groups.matching_limits: Realized rate limits differ: Luna sees none, Qwen one, Nemotron four, GLM five, and Kimi eight. This is a comparison of selected task histories, not a controlled replay of identical faults.
